items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [macos-autoproxy (⭐132)](https://github.com/SukkaW/zsh-osx-autoproxy) - Configures proxy environment variables based on macOS's system preferences.
*   [temperatures (⭐0)](https://github.com/groberth/temperatures-zsh) - A lightweight, zero-dependency plugin that shows your machine’s CPU and (optionally) GPU temperatures directly in your ZSH prompt. Originally designed for Raspberry Pi but works on any Linux system exposing `/sys/class/thermal/`.
items.content_html:
Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • macos-autoproxy (⭐132) - Configures proxy environment variables based on macOS's system preferences.
  • temperatures (⭐0) - A lightweight, zero-dependency plugin that shows your machine’s CPU and (optionally) GPU temperatures directly in your ZSH prompt. Originally designed for Raspberry Pi but works on any Linux system exposing /sys/class/thermal/.
